verdict.rationale: The CLI 'eject' command explicitly downloads full frontend and backend code from an app and creates a standalone project with its own app ID, enabling code export outside the platform, and this is corroborated by CLI overview docs and GitHub sync features for local development. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on confirmation that the exported app can be fully hosted/run with no Base44 backend dependency, and no detail on how backend services (DB, auth) are replicated outside the platform.
